mapper.select: SELECT tdm02_change_data AS change_data, tdm02_note AS note FROM ( /*--------- 미지정 책무 ---------*/ SELECT 1000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm10_task_class_cd , tdm14_task_type_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm10_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '미지정 책무' AS tdm02_change_data , CONCAT( '['|| f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm10_task_class_cd, tdm10_company_id, #{stdDate}::date) , '-' || tdm14_task_type_nm ||'] ' , tdm10_task_nm ) AS tdm02_note FROM tdm10_task INNER JOIN tdm14_task_type ON ( tdm14_company_id = tdm10_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm10_task_type_cd ) WHERE tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm20_role INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_role_id = tdm20_role_id WHERE tdm20_company_id = tdm10_company_id AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id ) /*--------- 임원 미배정 직책 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 2000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '임원 미배정 직책' AS tdm02_change_data , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm02_note FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}::date, false) WHERE tdm30_role_id = tdm20_role_id ) /*--------- 미동의 임원 (임원동의서 미결재) ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 2300 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '미동의 임원 (임원동의서 미결재)' AS tdm02_change_data , tdm20_role_nm ||' '|| f_emp_kor_nm(tdm30_person_id) AS tdm02_note FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}::date, false) LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm30_appr_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm30_role_id WHERE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') != '30' /*--------- 담당부서 미연결 직책 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 2500 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '담당부서 미연결 직책' AS tdm02_change_data , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm02_note FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm23_role_relate_org WHERE tdm23_role_id = tdm20_role_id ) /*--------- 책무 미연결 직책 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 2700 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '책무 미연결 직책' AS tdm02_change_data , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm02_note FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm10_task INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id WHERE tdm21_role_id = tdm20_role_id AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) ) /*--------- 개별책무 중복배정 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 3000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm10_task_class_cd , tdm14_task_type_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm10_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm20_role_nm) AS seq , '개별책무 중복배정' AS tdm02_change_data , CONCAT( '['|| f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm10_task_class_cd, tdm10_company_id, #{stdDate}::date) , '-' || tdm14_task_type_nm ||'] ' , tdm10_task_nm , ' ==> 직책 : ' || tdm20_role_nm ) AS tdm02_note FROM tdm10_task INNER JOIN tdm14_task_type ON ( tdm14_company_id = tdm10_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm10_task_type_cd ) INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm21_role_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT tdm10_task_id task_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT tdm10_task_id, tdm20_role_id FROM tdm10_task INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm21_role_id WHERE tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND COALESCE(tdm10_common_yn,'false') != 'true' ) t GROUP BY tdm10_task_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) tt ON task_id = tdm10_task_id WHERE tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) /*--------- CEO책무 배정 체크 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 3500 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm10_task_class_cd , tdm14_task_type_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm10_task_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm20_role_nm) AS seq , 'CEO책무 배정' AS tdm02_change_data , CONCAT( '['|| f_cdnm('TdmTaskClassCode', tdm10_task_class_cd, tdm10_company_id, #{stdDate}::date) , '-' || tdm14_task_type_nm ||'] ' , tdm10_task_nm , ' ==> 직책 : ' || tdm20_role_nm ) AS tdm02_note FROM tdm10_task INNER JOIN tdm14_task_type ON ( tdm14_company_id = tdm10_company_id AND tdm14_task_type_cd = tdm10_task_type_cd ) INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm21_role_id = tdm20_role_id WHERE tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date,'2999-12-31'::date) AND tdm10_ceo_yn = 'true' AND tdm20_role_type != 'C' /*--------- 책무대상인데, 임원정보 미등록 또는 퇴사 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 4000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY emp00_org_code_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , emp00_kor_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '인사정보 미갱신 : ' || CASE WHEN emp00_retire_date IS NOT NULL THEN '퇴직' ELSE '미등록' END AS tdm02_change_data , CONCAT( emp00_org_code_nm ||' ' , f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, emp00_company_id, #{stdDate}::date) ||' ' , emp00_kor_nm , CASE WHEN emp00_retire_date IS NOT NULL THEN ' (퇴사일:' || TO_CHAR(emp00_retire_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') ||')' ELSE '' END ) AS tdm02_note FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}::date) WHERE COALESCE(emp00_tdm_target_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = emp00_company_id AND tdm01_person_id = emp00_person_id AND COALESCE(tdm01_end_date, '2999-12-31'::date) > #{stdDate}::date ) OR COALESCE(emp00_retire_date, '2999-12-31'::date) <= #{stdDate}::date ) /*--------- 책무대상이 아닌데, 임원정보 등록 ---------*/ UNION ALL SELECT 5000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY emp00_org_code_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , emp00_kor_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS seq , '인사정보 미갱신 : 책무대상 해제' AS tdm02_change_data , emp00_org_code_nm ||' ' ||f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, emp00_company_id, #{stdDate}::date) ||' ' ||emp00_kor_nm ||CASE WHEN emp00_retire_date IS NOT NULL THEN ' (퇴사일:' || TO_CHAR(emp00_retire_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') ||')' ELSE '' END AS tdm02_note FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}::date) WHERE COALESCE(emp00_tdm_target_yn, 'false') = 'false' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm01_hr WHERE tdm01_company_id = emp00_company_id AND tdm01_person_id = emp00_person_id AND COALESCE(tdm01_end_date, '2999-12-31'::date) > #{stdDate}::date ) ) t ORDER BY seq
